prompt:
Create a photorealistic isolated catalog image of the exact white BMW X3 F25 facelift ordinary five-door SUV in the supplied photograph, representing the 2014–2017 body. Use a new coherent whole-vehicle camera with a balanced front three-quarter 1/2 view and the nose pointing right. Show both headlamps, the full kidney grille and bumper, and a substantial side projection. Rotate the whole car consistently rather than preserving the source camera or turning only its front.

Preserve its actual white gloss paint, silver longitudinal roof rails and chrome window outline, white mirror caps with their actual narrow repeaters and black bases, body-coloured handles, dark-silver paired multi-spoke alloy wheels, BMW centre roundels and complete tyres. Keep the facelift headlamps extending inward to the wide chrome kidneys, actual round fog lamps and washer covers, the ordinary bumper with two horizontal dark blades in each corner opening, and the silver lower trim. Retain actual small side emblems without inventing legible lettering. Do not substitute an M bumper, an earlier F25 or different catalogue wheels. Keep the real Australian right-hand-drive cabin and wiper orientation without mirroring it or converting it to left-hand drive.

The source has two silver longitudinal rails and no crossbars. At the rear centre of the roof a tiny white or silver upper antenna contour is visible behind its own rail, while its base and full height are self-occluded. Retain only that actual low exposed contour; do not invent a taller complete fin, a black fin, a mast or a panoramic roof, and do not use a generic BMW accessory shape. The visible contour around original pixels x962–1004 and y123–133 is evidence of a low exposed part, not a measurement of its physical dimensions.

Remove recognisable houses, trees, fences, people and road surfaces, including their identifiable reflections in the body and glass. Keep the actual white colour, gloss finish, black plastic material and silver trim with simple soft studio highlights and an unobtrusive actual interior. Preserving equipment and shape does not mean retaining the old environmental mapping. Clean dirt and minor surface blemishes without changing physical trim. Use a blank neutral plate and retain manufacturer emblems.

Return a true transparent RGBA PNG with the whole vehicle, tyres, mirrors, rails, low antenna contour and bumpers within generous transparent margins of at least 100 pixels on every side including the bottom. There must be no floor, contact shadow, reflection below the vehicle, halo, glow, coloured fringe or detached alpha specks. Keep a clean finely antialiased outline and do not crop or stretch the car.
